position: Private demo handoff, not public launch
headline: The backend spike now has a founder-readable demo packet.
copy: This release turns the local API, contract tests, adapter fallback, and launch locks into a single handoff that a founder can run and review.

postures.title: Demo script
postures.copy: Run server, call health, call source, run contract checks, review locks.

postures.title: Handoff packet
postures.copy: Script outputs the next decision and boundaries.

postures.title: UI fallback
postures.copy: The product can explain missing local API safely.

postures.title: Production backend
postures.copy: Next choice is the smallest real service slice.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: Still requires rights, privacy, security, support, reviewer operations, and real corpus controls.

flow.title: Prepare
flow.copy: Run contract tests from a clean worktree.

flow.title: Demo
flow.copy: Start the local API and ask two source questions.

flow.title: Review
flow.copy: Check packet fields and fallback behavior.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Approve or reject a real backend spike scope.

decisions.label: Private demo
decisions.reason: Useful for founder review of source packet behavior.

decisions.label: Backend spike
decisions.reason: Choose Node route, serverless route, or hosted prototype after review.

decisions.label: Trust posture
decisions.reason: No answer should appear without visible source or visible no-source reason.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled by this release.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed source text delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Do not demo this as real AI, real corpus retrieval, therapeutic help, spiritual authority, or production software.
